title: Principal Partner  Engineer, SAARC (Based in Bangalore)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Bengaluru, India</li> <li>India</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Principal Partner Solution Engineer (PSE) is a high-impact, strategic technical sales leader  responsible for end-to-end technical lifecycle and enablement of the assigned partners, managing both pre-sales and post-sales engineering activities. In this role, you will act as the single technical point of contact as the trusted advisory for your assigned partners, driving technical validation during the sales cycle, architecting their delivery readiness and ensuring ongoing Partner Success.</p> <p>The role focuses heavily on driving value-based solution selling to accelerate the adoption of Cloudflare platform with focus on One (SASE/SSE) and AI Infrastructure (Workers AI / AI Gateway). By cultivating deeply technical champions within the partner organization, aligning architectures to tangible business outcomes, optimizing post-sales delivery and building joint managed services offering, you will directly expand and influence the pipeline to maximize Partner-Influenced Opportunity (PIO) revenue.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <h3>1. Pre-Sales Engineering & Champion Building</h3> <ul> <li>Technical Alignment, Discovery & Enablement: Own the technical relationship with Partners to align on building joint Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies. Align, build, and accelerate partner technical capabilities, enabling them to lead deep technical discovery and architectural design to independently sell scalable solutions leveraging the Cloudflare Platform with a strong focus on AI and Cloudflare One (CF1).</li> <li>Technical Account Plan Ownership: Own and drive the end-to-end Technical Account Plan (TAP) for assigned strategic partners. Act as the primary architect mapping partner business goals to technical execution milestones, ensuring continuous alignment on CF1 and AI adoption targets.</li> <li>Building Technical Champions: Identify, enable, and cultivate key technical advocates and "Champions" within the partner organization to scale Cloudflare expertise independently, generate Partner-Influenced Opportunities (PIO), and empower them to deliver high-value professional services around Zero Trust and AI application security.</li> <li>Driving PIO via Next-Gen Architectures: Collaborate with sales teams to proactively source, qualify, and expand PIO through strategic architectural alignment, focusing on migrating legacy network architectures to CF1 and integrating secure AI solutions.</li> <li>Deal Support & Qualification: Enable partners' technical validation, proof-of-concept (PoC), demo, pipeline generation, and pipeline acceleration capabilities. Identify joint pursuit accounts, facilitate strategic technical account planning, and deliver cutting-edge solution architecture sessions for Named Partners</li> </ul> <h3>2. Accelerate Services Delivery</h3> <ul> <li>ASD Partner Journey Ownership: Own the ASD partner journey to ensure partners possess the advanced capabilities required to deploy, manage, and support the Cloudflare platform and AI application workloads seamlessly.</li> <li>Joint Services Offering Acceleration with strong focus on CF1 and A1: Build and co-develop joint services catalogues with key partners, accelerating the creation and launch of their own Cloudflare-focused services offerings, managed CF1 SASE practices, and AI security assessments.</li> <li>Service Monetization & Performance Metrics: Enable partners to embed CF1 and Workers AI capabilities into their own managed security portfolios to shorten time-to-market, protect client AI pipelines, and maximize profitability. Develop, manage, and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and improve the effectiveness of these partner service deliveries</li> <li>Technical Account Management & Architectural Health: Act as the escalated technical point of contact to ensure long-term architectural health, utilizing telemetry and proactive design to move the partner relationship from reactive to strategics for Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <h3>3. Automation AI Agents & Continuous Innovation</h3> <ul> <li>Leverage Autonomous AI Tools: Champion the use of Cloudflare OS and AI tools (Agent PAT and Agent Echo) to automate standard, repeatable technical tasks, optimizing operational efficiency and freeing up bandwidth for high-touch, strategic partner engagements.</li> <li>AI & CF1 Product Enhancement Feedback Loop: Engage partner champions in the Partner Technical Advisory Council (PTAC) to give them early access to beta software, capture raw product feedback, and drive joint co-innovation on CF1 features and emerging AI products.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Enablement: Participate in continuous cross-training programs to maintain peak proficiency in both pre-sales scoping and post-sales service deployment across the entire Cloudflare One and AI ecosystem.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of technical, partner-facing experience (e.g., Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Account Manager) in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or networking.</li> <li>Strong technical depth in Cloudflare One (CF1) or equivalent SASE/SSE architectures, Zero Trust, DNS, and application security, alongside hands-on familiarity with AI deployment, AI Gateway, LLM orchestration frameworks, or vector databases.</li> <li>Proven track record of developing technical talent or building "champion" programs within partner organizations, specifically driving adoption of complex cloud networks and AI technologies.</li> <li>Enterprise Architecture & Project Management: Deep understanding of enterprise IT, multi-cloud, and hybrid cloud environment while managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to manage the technical lifecycle of a deal from initial pre-sales discovery and CF1/AI PIO generation through post-sale service delivery.</li> <li>Strong communication skills with a track record of presenting complex CF1 architectures and AI-driven use cases to partner leadership and technical teams alike.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. title: Manager Robotic Sales Engineering
description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious Manager Robotic Sales Engineering (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions. Your mission Robotic Sales Engineers (RSEs) are RobCo’s technical face to the customer. They qualify opportunities, run requirement workshops, check feasibility and drive each deal to a concept our Solutions Development team can build. As Manager Robotic Sales Engineering, you lead a team of around six RSEs and report to the Head of Robotic Sales Engineering. You make sure every deal gets the right technical lead, every customer gets a consistent experience and every RSE on your team keeps getting better. You carry a quota together with Sales and are measured on whether your team hits it. You are a player-coach. You lead the team, and you still go on-site for the deals that matter most. You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help scale how RobCo brings physical AI into real production. What you will do Lead and grow the team – Hire, onboard and coach your RSEs. Run regular 1:1s, give clear feedback, write performance reviews and build real career paths. Deliver the quota – Own your team’s quota together with your Sales counterparts. Track pipeline and win rates, spot deals at risk early and put your team’s capacity where it moves the number. Steer the deal portfolio – Match RSEs to Account Executives and deals, balance workload and set priorities together with Sales and Delivery, so no customer waits and no deal slips. Raise the quality bar – Set the standard for discovery, requirement workshops, feasibility checks and handovers. Review the critical concepts before they go to the customer or to Solutions Development. Be hands-on where it counts – Join strategic accounts and complex workshops yourself, and be the technical escalation point for customers and AEs. Own the interfaces – Work closely with Sales leadership, Solutions Development and Product to keep handovers clean and expectations aligned. Improve how we work – Shape the team’s processes, templates, tools and KPIs, and turn field insights into input for Product. What you bring 5+ years in technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects, including 2+ years leading a team You’ve run requirement workshops, won deals yourself and worked against a quota, so you know what it takes to hit it You still enjoy being in front of customers and are credible with an engineer on the shop floor and a plant manager deciding on the investment You make people better: you coach, give direct feedback and know when to step in and when to let your team own it You set clear priorities when everything feels urgent, and you can explain them to sales, engineering and management alike You build structure that helps the team move faster, not process for its own sake You speak German and English fluently You are happy to travel, around 30% of the time Experience in physical AI (AI-based perception, learning-based manipulation, autonomous robots) is a plus Experience building or scaling a team in a fast-growing company is a plus A background at a robot manufacturer or system integrator is a plus Why join RobCo? Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation. Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time. As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work. Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development. Work out across Germany in over 7,200 studios with our subsidized Wellpass membership. Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home. Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest. About RobCo Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco. Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements. title: Regional Sales Director, Commercial - LATAM
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p>An overview of this role</p> <p>As the Regional Director, Commercial Sales - LATAM, you'll lead a team of Commercial Account Executives to grow adoption of GitLab's artificial intelligence (AI)-powered DevSecOps platform, which brings together software development, security, and operations. You'll own software sales, bookings, and revenue across the region, helping new and existing customers increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, and reduce security and compliance risk.</p> <p>You’ll also build a foundational operational discipline, including a defined sales cadence, a common methodology (MEDDPICC and Command of the Message) applied consistently across the team, and a partner strategy that multiplies regional coverage.</p> <p>Reporting to the Area Vice President, LATAM, you'll hire and develop your team, set territory and industry strategies, and align regional sales plans with GitLab's growth goals. In your first year, you'll focus on building a strong team culture, deepening customer relationships across LATAM, and consistently meeting or exceeding performance objectives.</p> <p>What you'll do</p> <ul> <li>Lead, coach, and develop Commercial Account Executives serving the LATAM market to deliver software sales, bookings, and revenue results.</li> <li>Build territory and industry plans based on market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive trends, and turn those plans into growth opportunities.</li> <li>Establish that operating rhythm including qualification standards, pipeline hygiene, deal inspection, and forecast accuracy.</li> <li>Own accurate sales forecasts, territory management plans, and regional growth strategies aligned with GitLab's revenue goals.</li> <li>Establish, track, and report on team performance metrics, and address gaps through coaching and changes to regional plans.</li> <li>Partner with Renewals, Marketing, and Sales Operations to manage pipeline health, renewal performance, and deal execution.</li> <li>Recruit, hire, and onboard sales talent, and maintain a pipeline of potential future hires in the region.</li> <li>Build an inclusive, positive team culture through regular coaching, clear expectations, and ongoing development.</li> <li>Enable your team on GitLab's product, pricing, AI-powered DevSecOps positioning, and industry and regulatory factors relevant to LATAM markets.</li> </ul> <p>What you'll bring</p> <ul> <li>Progressive experience in field sales and sales operations in open source software, DevOps, or a similar software-as-a-service environment. We welcome transferable leadership and regional sales experience from adjacent software markets.</li> <li>Success leading and developing account-focused sales teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.</li> <li>A track record of meeting or exceeding revenue, pipeline, and other sales performance objectives.</li> <li>Experience building and executing go-to-market strategies for LATAM, with a willingness to lead your team and participate directly in selling.</li> <li>Commercial and analytical skills to interpret sales performance, market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics, and use those insights to improve regional plans.</li> <li>Practical experience using customer relationship management (CRM) and sales and marketing tools, such as Salesforce, Clari, or Marketo, to manage forecasts, territories, and pipeline.</li> <li>Relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills, including executive-level written and verbal communication and the ability to mentor others.</li> <li>Interest in open source and a commitment to GitLab's values of collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.</li> </ul> <p>About the team</p> <p>You'll join our Sales organization in the Commercial LATAM region. As an all-remote team, we collaborate across time zones using asynchronous workflows. We drive new and expansion revenue and partner with Renewals, Marketing, and Sales Operations to serve customers across LATAM.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>As a Staff Security Governance Engineer, you will be the individual contributor who owns how GitLab writes, maintains, communicates, and measures its security policies and standards. You will turn emerging regulations, including AI regulation, into clear requirements that engineering, product, and legal teams can act on, and you will use automation to keep governance lightweight and continuous rather than a point-in-time exercise. You will sit on the Security Governance team within Security Assurance and work closely with Security Compliance, Security Risk, and GRC Engineering. You will report to the Director, Customer Trust & Security Governance.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li><em>Policies and standards</em></li> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end lifecycle of GitLab's security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines: drafting, stakeholder review, approval, publication, annual review, and retirement.</li> <li>Define and run the exception management process, including risk-based approvals, expiry tracking, and trend reporting that shows where policies need to change.</li> <li>Run policy attestation and investigate non-adherence.</li> <li>Keep policies clear, practical, and aligned with how GitLab's engineering teams work in a DevSecOps environment.</li> </ul> <li><em>Regulatory and framework alignment</em></li> <ul> <li>Monitor emerging regulations and standards (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, sector or regional requirements) and partner with Legal well ahead of compliance deadlines to assess impact and update policy.</li> <li>Maintain mappings between our policies and frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, FedRAMP, and NIST CSF, so requirements are written once and reused.</li> </ul> <li><em>Measurement and assurance</em></li> <ul> <li>Define KPIs for policy adherence and report trends to Security leadership.</li> <li>Run targeted internal assessments of adherence and drive remediation to closure.</li> <li>Support audit activities by coordinating evidence, testing, and remediation management.</li> </ul> <li><em>Customer trust</em></li> <ul> <li>Support customer questionnaires and customer meetings, and help turn recurring customer requests into better policies and self-service content.</li> </ul> <li><em>Automation and AI</em></li> <ul> <li>Identify and implement automation and AI-assisted workflows for policy management, evidence collection, control monitoring, and assessment work, in partnership with GRC Engineering.</li> </ul> <li><em>Technical leadership</em></li> <ul> <li>Act as a technical and program leader across Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering, influencing without direct authority.</li> <li>Mentor other team members and help set the direction of the Security Governance roadmap.</li> </ul> </ul> <h4><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>10+ years in security governance, GRC, or IT risk, with hands-on ownership of a policy and standards lifecycle and measurable outcomes, ideally at a global technology company.</li> <li>Working knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, FedRAMP, and NIST CSF, including how to put them into practice, not only how to read them</li> <li>Experience creating and maintaining an enterprise Information Security Management System (ISMS), ideally including hands on involvement in ISO 27001 certification or recertification.<span class="screenreader-hidden-offscreen"> </span></li> <li>Understanding of cloud, SaaS, and DevSecOps practices, and the ability to write policy that engineers will follow.</li> <li>A risk-based mindset that balances compliance with real security risk.</li> <li>Demonstrated use of automation or AI to reduce manual GRC work.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, including translating technical concepts for engineers, executives, auditors, and customers.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering.</li> <li>Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or similar are highly desirable.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What success looks like</strong></h4> <ul> <li>First 30 days: Assessed the current policy library and exception process, built relationships with key stakeholders, and proposed a prioritized roadmap.</li> <li>First 90 days: Uplift the existing security policy library to align with NIST CSF, ISO 27001/27017/27018/42001, and PCI-DSS.</li> <li>First 120 days: A refreshed review cadence is in place, exception reporting is running, and can demonstrate a measurable improvement in policy adherence.</li> <li>First six months: Develop Policy as Code and collaborate with Security, Product, Legal, and Engineering for implementation into existing workflows.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>The Security Assurance organization helps GitLab build and maintain trust by strengthening how we approach security, compliance, and risk. Security Governance sits within it and owns customer trust, security awareness, policies and standards, and other governance functions. Our counterparts are Security Compliance, Security Risk, and GRC Engineering. <br><br>You will join a small team of four direct reports under the Director, where each person has broad scope and visible impact. We work remote-first and asynchronously, and we write things down and share them openly, so you'll draft and revise policies and standards in the open with input from Security, Legal, Product, and Engineering.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Senior Finance Business Analyst (Safeguarding, Treasury & Accounting)
description: Role: Senior Finance Business Analyst (Safeguarding, Treasury & Accounting) Start Date: ASAP Employment Type: Fixed Term Contract – 3 Months Location: Hybrid (London) Programme: FCA Cryptoasset Regulatory Regime / CASS 17 Implementation Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced Senior Finance Business Analyst to support a high-profile regulatory programme focused on the implementation of the FCA Cryptoasset Regime. Working across Finance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Compliance, Risk and Technology, you will play a key role in translating regulatory requirements into practical operating models, controls, processes and technology solutions. This role will focus on the design and implementation of frameworks required under CASS 17 , including cryptoasset safeguarding, reconciliation, record keeping, governance and financial control processes. Key Responsibilities: Gather, analyse and document business, regulatory and operational requirements relating to the FCA Cryptoasset Regime. Translate CASS 17 safeguarding requirements into detailed business processes, controls and operating procedures. Conduct current-state and target-state assessments across Finance, Treasury and Accounting functions. Define reconciliation, record-keeping and client asset safeguarding requirements for cryptoasset activities. Support impact assessments across people, process, data, controls and technology. Facilitate workshops with senior stakeholders across Finance, Treasury, Operations, Compliance, Product and Technology. Produce business requirements, process maps, user stories and functional specifications. Partner with SMEs to design governance, oversight and control frameworks. Identify regulatory, operational and financial risks and support remediation planning. Ensure alignment between regulatory obligations, operating model design and technology delivery. Support programme governance, reporting and stakeholder communications. Required Experience Extensive experience as a Business Analyst within Financial Services. Strong understanding of Finance, Treasury and Accounting processes. Proven experience delivering regulatory change programmes. Experience gathering requirements and producing high-quality BA artefacts. Ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders across multiple functions. Strong process mapping, gap analysis and operating model design experience. Experience working on complex cross-functional transformation programmes. Desirable Experience Knowledge of FCA regulations and regulatory change delivery. Experience working within Client Assets (CASS), Safeguarding or Asset Protection frameworks. title: Staff Corporate Security Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. You will work across endpoint management, identity, and security operations to improve how GitLab manages macOS, iOS, Windows, and Linux devices through Infrastructure-as-Code, Terraform, and GitOps workflows. In your first year, you'll be expected to strengthen endpoint security architecture, expand automation, and improve the reliability and auditability of how controls are deployed and maintained.</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Lead the security architecture of GitLab's endpoint fleet and related infrastructure, with a primary focus on macOS.</li> <li>Design and support automation for secure endpoint deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management using code-based workflows.</li> <li>Manage endpoint and SaaS security configuration through Terraform, version control, merge requests, continuous integration pipelines, and automated rollouts.</li> <li>Define and enforce security baselines across macOS, iOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints.</li> <li>Develop patching and software distribution approaches that align with security, compliance, and operational requirements.</li> <li>Partner with Information Technology, Security Operations, and Detection and Response teams to improve endpoint telemetry, detections, and response models.</li> <li>Drive process improvements that reduce manual work and lower risk by favoring automation, policy-driven controls, and auditable change management.</li> <li>Mentor engineers across Corporate Security and Information Technology, and serve as a senior escalation point for complex endpoint security issues.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Experience designing and delivering endpoint, systems, or corporate security solutions in environments that require scalable, durable controls.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of endpoint management platforms such as Jamf Pro or FleetDM, especially for architecting and securing macOS environments.</li> <li>Strong hands-on ability with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices, including module design, state management, and pipeline-based deployment.</li> <li>Experience working with GitOps workflows where changes are managed through Git repositories, merge requests, code review, and automated pipelines.</li> <li> Strong proficiency in scripting or programming for automation and security tooling, such as bash, Python, PowerShell, or Go.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud identity providers and directories, including platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, LDAP.</li> <li>Ability to communicate clearly, collaborate across distributed teams, and work independently in an all-remote environment.</li> <li>Openness to bringing transferable experience from adjacent security, systems, or platform engineering backgrounds, along with a practical and security-focused approach to problem solving.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>About the team</strong></h4> <p>The Corporate Security Engineering team secures the internal environment GitLab team members use every day, including endpoints, identity systems, SaaS applications, and platforms that store sensitive internal data. It's a small, high-leverage team that treats security work as engineering work: building with code, operating through Git, and using reviewable, testable, and auditable workflows by default. title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description: Senior Infrastructure Engineer Remote (UK-based), with occasional on-site work at our data centres | Full-Time About Us Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year ( Risk.net ). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 50+ of the world’s leading liquidity providers. We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what’s technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems. The Role We’re looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to help run and grow the network and cloud estate behind our trading platform. Networking in our colocation data centres is the core of the role. The estate spans London, New York and Singapore, and from Q1 2027 a new Tokyo data centre. This is a hands-on role in a small, expert infrastructure team. You’ll work closely with our Head of Infrastructure, following problems from the cross-connect through hosts, containers and AWS. You’ll also help keep infrastructure delivery on track, from timelines and reporting to working closely with our TechOps team. What You’ll Work On Low-latency networking across our colocation sites: switching and routing, cross-connects, BGP peering with liquidity providers and clients, and the fabric that carries our trading traffic Bringing new sites to application-ready, starting with Tokyo Our hybrid connectivity into multi-region AWS, including Direct Connect, routing and failover Linux hosts and containers on the critical path, with every change made through code (Ansible, Git, Terraform), never by hand Monitoring and alerting that catches problems before clients do, plus runbooks and post-incident reviews that someone else can follow Planning and capacity: forecasting growth, setting timelines and reporting progress to TechOps and engineering What We Need 4+ years running production infrastructure in a latency-sensitive environment, such as HFT, an exchange, market data or bank trading infrastructure Strong networking: hands-on routing and switching (MLAG, LACP, VLANs), BGP in production, and a solid grasp of low-latency behaviour such as buffers, microbursts and congestion handling Colocation experience: cabinets, cross-connects, remote hands and vendor management Solid Linux (RHEL) and TCP/IP, and the ability to trace a problem from the wire to the application Infrastructure as code and containers as your default way of working Working knowledge of AWS networking, and the confidence to pick up the rest of our stack. Networking depth matters more to us than any particular cloud or platform tooling Methodical, evidence-led troubleshooting and clear documentation A strong plus: Project management experience: owning timelines, reporting progress, and working with ops teams to hit deadlines Kernel bypass (Onload/ef_vi), PTP and time synchronisation Experience bringing up a new colo site FIX protocol or OTC FX market knowledge Python for tooling Working pattern: Infrastructure changes are often scheduled outside trading hours, including weekends, and the team shares an on-call rota. We’re a team with flexible hours, so time worked out of hours is taken back during the week. Day-to-day work is remote, with occasional visits to our data centres, most often in London (Slough). What You Get Real ownership of a live global trading network, hands-on, with few layers of process A build-out year, with a new Tokyo data centre in Q1 and more growth ahead A senior seat in a small, expert team where your changes ship and are measured Competitive package — up to 38 days leave (inc. bank holidays), private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites Remote-friendly working with flexibility around out-of-hours work Growth as the estate scales We believe in transparency, honest feedback and writing things down, and we aim to build systems that don’t depend on the heroics of individuals. Our Hiring Process We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages: Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes Stage 2: Technical Deep Dive with our Head of Infrastructure Format: Video call, interactive session, ~90 minutes Stage 3: Leadership Conversation with our CDO Format: Video call, ~45 minutes What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you’re invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days. How to Apply Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you’ll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role. Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation. Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’re happy to accommodate. Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy. #Hiring #Infrastructure #Networking #LowLatency #TradingTechnology #FinTech #Remote #Colocation Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sales & Operations Specialist, RC Capital
description: RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading. The Role RC Capital is RevenueCat's first move into financial services. Our first product, Early Payouts, gives developers access to App Store proceeds without waiting the usual 30 to 60 days for Apple and Google to pay them. As Sales & Operations Specialist, RC Capital, you will own the customer lifecycle end-to-end - from identifying and qualifying suitable prospects through screening, onboarding, activation, ongoing support, account operations, and portfolio health. You will combine commercial judgment, customer care, operational discipline, and risk awareness to help RC Capital acquire and serve more healthy customers. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role on a small founding team. You might move from a discovery call to an onboarding issue, a portfolio review, and a workflow improvement in the same day. You will work closely with Sales, Support, Product, Data, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and GTM Operations, and report to the VP of Strategy & Operations. You will also help build the playbook and systems future teammates inherit. What You'll Own: Sales and qualification. Manage a portfolio of inbound and targeted outbound opportunities. Run discovery, assess product and customer fit, coordinate screening, handle objections, maintain momentum, and guide suitable prospects to a clear decision. Onboarding and activation. Lead approved customers from decision to activated. Ensure customers understand how to use Early Payouts successfully. Customer support and portfolio operations. Serve as a reliable point of contact for customers, including questions, disputes, and operational issues. Coordinate with RevenueCat Support and specialist teams, and own follow-through through resolution. Risk-aware execution. Apply documented customer, fraud, and risk policies consistently; investigate issues; document decisions; monitor emerging patterns; and make sound recommendations. Escalate exceptions and regulated or high-impact decisions to the appropriate risk, legal, finance, or leadership owner. Lifecycle performance and insight. Maintain a reliable view of pipeline, onboarding, support demand, usage, and portfolio health. Turn data into recommendations on funnel quality, conversion, time to activation, drop-off, retention, customer experience, and risk indicators. Bring structured customer insight to Product to inform roadmaps. Systems, automation, and playbooks. Improve CRM, support workflows, internal handoffs, reporting, documentation, and automation. Use AI thoughtfully to reduce manual work and response times without weakening controls or customer trust. Partner with Marketing, Operations, Data, and Product on durable implementations. Customer and growth. Partner with Marketing on focused acquisition and lifecycle experiments. Support marketing efforts like campaign execution, competitive analysis, and content that drives demand. What We're Looking For 4+ years in a high-ownership, customer-facing commercial or operations role spanning sales, account management, customer success, customer support, or customer operations. A track record of moving opportunities through a commercial process and managing a meaningful volume of customer relationships with strong follow-through. Experience in fintech, payments, lending, factoring, embedded finance, or another environment where customer growth and operational risk are closely connected. 1-2 years of marketing or growth experience running campaigns or managing CRM-driven outreach. Strong operational judgment: you clarify ownership, define next steps, document decisions, apply policy consistently, and recognize when an issue needs specialist review. Analytical fluency across CRM, support, and analytics tools, with the ability to diagnose funnel or portfolio performance and recommend action. Practical experience improving workflows with automation and AI, including judgment about where automation introduces unacceptable risk or a poor customer experience. Excellent written and verbal communication: persuasive with prospects, clear during onboarding, calm in disputes, and concise with executives and cross-functional partners. Comfort operating in ambiguity on a small, autonomous team and working hours that meaningfully overlap with US time zones. Nice to Have Direct experience with payment operations, underwriting, fraud and risk workflows, disputes, or compliance-adjacent processes. Experience launching a new product, business line, or operating motion before the playbook was written. Knowledge of mobile apps, developer products, subscriptions, or App Store economics. Experience contributing to CRM or lifecycle campaigns, customer-facing content, or growth experiments. Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Notion, Linear, Intercom or Zendesk, Slack, Zoom, and product analytics platforms. What success looks like In your first 30 days Understand RC Capital's product, customers, unit economics, risk model, and role within RevenueCat. Map the lifecycle from first signal through activation and live-account support. Establish baseline reporting for pipeline quality, conversion, time to decision, time to activation, support demand, repeat usage, and portfolio health. Shadow sales, onboarding, support, risk, and account reviews; then handle initial customer interactions with support. Ship one concrete improvement to a workflow, report, playbook, or automation. By 90 days Independently own a portfolio from qualification and screening through onboarding and ongoing operations, escalating genuine exceptions appropriately. Give the team a reliable view of pipeline, onboarding, support, usage, and portfolio performance, with recommendations rather than reporting alone. Run a consistent cadence for opportunity follow-up, onboarding, live-account reviews, and issue resolution. Ship workflow or automation improvements that reduce manual work or customer wait time without weakening controls. Support marketing efforts to deliver on targets. Translate recurring customer and operational friction into structured recommendations for Product, Data, Finance, Legal, Support, or Marketing. By 6 to 12 months Improve key lifecycle measures such as conversion, activation speed, utilization and retention. Help grow a portfolio of healthy customers while keeping fraud, disputes, losses, and other agreed risk indicators within guardrails. Maintain a commercial and customer-operations playbook another teammate can follow without relying on context held only in people's heads. Help turn the early motion into a repeatable engine and identify which responsibilities should move to partner teams or future hires as volume grows. What we offer: Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator 10-year window to exercise vested equity options A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually Paid desk at a co-working space Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend Interviewing at RevenueCat Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? title: Data Analyst
description: RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading. The role We're hiring a Data Analyst to work as close as possible to the teams that run RevenueCat's business, including Marketing, Sales, Finance, People, Ops, Product, etc. The most valuable thing on our Analytics team today isn't SQL, it's domain knowledge. Knowing what a trial start actually counts, why tracked revenue and realized revenue are different, how store refunds land in our data, and which model answers a question correctly the first time. That knowledge is what turns a half-formed Slack question into a number someone can act on within the hour. So you'll spend most of your time with business teams: understanding what they're trying to decide, turning vague questions into analysis, and shipping the datasets and dashboards they rely on. You'll build that domain knowledge fast, working day to day with the person who currently owns Analytics here. He'll be your closest partner and the person who helps you grow into the domain. The second thing that makes this role exciting is how we expect you to work. We're building the infrastructure that lets AI agents access our data safely, and agentic tooling that answers questions grounded in our semantic layer rather than guessing. You'll be one of its heaviest users and one of the people who makes it trustworthy: curating the semantic context, catching the answers that look right and aren't, and pushing definitions back into dbt and LookML where they belong. We're not hiring someone to do the same volume of work faster, we're hiring someone who supports multiple teams well using this collection of new tools as a force multiplier. What you will do Partner regularly with Marketing, Sales, Finance and Product teams. Learn their goals, their metrics, and the decisions they're actually stuck on. Own analysis end to end: clarify the real question, build or pick the right dataset, deliver the answer, and make sure a decision follows. Go deep on our subscription domain, then write it down. Metric definitions, caveats, always-filters, known gotchas. Domain knowledge that only lives in your head doesn't scale, and scaling it is the point of this role. Build analytics assets people trust without asking you first: models in dbt, explores in LookML, dashboards that hold up. Use our agent tooling as a force multiplier and contribute back to it. Feed it semantic context, flag wrong answers, harden the definitions it depends on. Contribute to the data platform where it unblocks you. Small model and pipeline improvements, debugging discrepancies, helping out when something breaks. Translate in both directions: business context into robust analysis, data reality into language a non-technical stakeholder can act on. About you 3+ years in an analytics role (Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Analyst, Analytics Engineer or similar), including real experience as the direct analytics partner to a business team such as Marketing, Sales or Finance. Curiosity is the thing we're actually screening for: You're uncomfortable when you don't understand why a number is what it is, and you dig until you do. You ask the question behind the question. When someone asks for a dashboard, you find out what decision it's for. You'd rather learn a new domain than a new tool. You're comfortable without fully formed requirements, and you create structure where none exists yet. You care more about being useful and clear than about polished dashboards. You want to be a partner to the business, not a request queue. From a skills perspective, you bring: Strong SQL and real comfort working directly in a warehouse. You can get to an answer without hand-holding. Experience owning datasets and dashboards that non-technical teams depend on. Comfortable working in a repo: git, branches, pull requests, code review. Our analytics lives in version-controlled dbt and LookML repos, not in saved queries. You already work with AI agents daily and you're appropriately skeptical of them. You can explain how you verified an answer, not just how you produced one. Clear written communication, especially about limits, caveats, and what a number does not say. Nice to have, and genuinely not required: Python, dbt, Looker or LookML, Snowflake or ClickHouse Subscription or fintech domain experience High-volume data What we offer: Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator 10-year window to exercise vested equity options A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually Paid desk at a co-working space Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend Interviewing at RevenueCat Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat , including tips to help you succeed. More on how we work: How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team The values that guide how we work: Our Values How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

You automate relentlessly and ship pipelines that scale. title: Service Monteur Warmtepompen
description: De meeste monteurs in Nederland vervangen vandaag nog steeds ketels die er over tien jaar niet meer staan. Ben je loodgieter, servicemonteur of cv-monteur? Bij ons stap je over op de techniek die daarvoor in de plaats komt. Ervaring met warmtepompen hoeft niet, die leren we je. Wat je wel meeneemt is je gevoel voor leidingwerk. Geen storingsdienst, een volledig uitgeruste bus, en je werkdag begint als je instapt. WIJ MAKEN WARMTE ZONDER GAS Wist je dat wij onze warmtepompen zelf ontwerpen? Met een club van rond de zestig mensen bedenken we ze, assembleren we ze in Utrecht en installeren we ze zelf. Voor huiseigenaren door heel Nederland en sinds dit jaar ook in Duitsland. Vorig jaar won onze Pomp MP als eerste warmtepomp ooit zowel de iF Design Award Gold als de Red Dot. Elke week gaan er tientallen huizen van het gas af. Het doel is 10% van alle Nederlandse woningen, ongeveer 800.000 huizen. De vraag is er en het product staat. De rem zit op hoe snel we kunnen leveren. Dat lukt niet zonder jou als servicemonteur. WAT JIJ HIER DOET Onderhoud aan onze warmtepompen Storingen oplossen die het serviceteam niet op afstand kon verhelpen Installaties inspecteren en optimaliseren Klanten uitleggen wat er aan de hand is, in gewone taal Terugkoppelen wat je in het veld ziet, zodat het product beter wordt Ongeveer de helft van de storingen zit in onze eigen warmtepomp, waterzijdig of elektrisch. De andere helft zit in de woninginstallatie. Een radiator die niet warm wordt hebben wij niet geplaatst, maar we sturen de klant niet weg. Dat lossen we ook op. WAAROM MONTEURS BIJ ONS BLIJVEN Geen storingsdienst. Geen consignatie. Reistijd is werktijd. En jij kiest zelf tussen dertien ADV-dagen of meer salaris per maand. Ons serviceteam op kantoor lost ongeveer negen van de tien meldingen op afstand op en plant jouw week in. Jij rijdt naar de klanten waar echt iemand langs moet. Je krijgt geen telefoon om acht uur ’s avonds. Loop je bij een klant vast, dan bellen onze specialisten in en kijken ze met je mee. Die zitten bij ons in dienst, dus je hebt ze binnen een minuut aan de lijn. Geen half uur in de wacht bij een ketelmerk dat er geen belang bij heeft dat jouw storing vandaag opgelost wordt. Wij hebben hetzelfde doel als jij, dus die stap slaan we over. Zit iemand in het weekend zonder warm water, dan schakelen wij een cv-monteur in en betalen dat zelf. Onze warmtepompboiler heeft bovendien een elektrisch element, dus niemand staat koud. Je werkt zelfstandig vanuit je bus, maar je zit in een serviceteam en hebt korte lijnen met het magazijn en met productontwikkeling. WAT DIT JE OPLEVERT Over twee jaar ken jij deze systemen beter dan bijna iedereen in dit land, simpelweg omdat er nog maar weinig mensen zijn die er dagelijks aan werken. Dat is een positie die je zelf in handen hebt, en die alleen maar meer waard wordt. Daar komt bij: omdat wij het product zelf maken, gaat wat jij in het veld ziet rechtstreeks naar de engineers. Je lost niet alleen storingen op, je zorgt dat ze de volgende keer niet meer voorkomen. WAT JE MEEBRENGT Een paar jaar ervaring als loodgieter, servicemonteur, storingsmonteur, installatiemonteur W, cv-monteur of monteur werktuigbouwkundige installaties Of een technische mbo-opleiding met de praktijkervaring die daarbij hoort. Starters zoeken we niet Ervaring met leidingwerk. Dat is het enige wat we niet in een paar maanden kunnen bijbrengen. De elektra kant en onze eigen warmtepompen leren we je wel Rijbewijs B Nederlands of Engels waarmee je een klant kunt uitleggen wat er aan de hand is Zin om een nieuwe techniek onder de knie te krijgen Bij de klant ben jij DeWarmte. Iemand moet blij zijn dat jij binnenkomt en het gevoel hebben: die gaat het voor mij oplossen. En omdat we hard groeien, is de situatie op locatie niet altijd zoals hij op je werkbon staat. Soms wil de klant er nog iets bij, soms is de voorbereiding niet compleet. Dan zoek jij een oplossing in plaats van een schuldige. Twijfel je of je past? Bel of app Marvin even op 06 1111 9775. We zoeken nu versterking in de driehoek Zwolle, Apeldoorn en Deventer. Woon je daar in de buurt, dan zetten we een voorraadpunt bij jou in de regio neer zodat je niet steeds naar Utrecht hoeft. WAT JE KRIJGT – € 3.000 tot € 5.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van je ervaring – Een werkweek van 38 uur, of 40 uur met dertien ADV-dagen. Jij kiest – Parttime kan ook, vanaf 24 uur per week – 25 vakantiedagen bij fulltime, plus 8% vakantiegeld dat we maandelijks uitbetalen – Een volledig uitgeruste bedrijfsbus, laptop en telefoon – Reistijd is werktijd, vanaf het moment dat je instapt – Opleidingen en trainingen tot je specialist bent in warmtepompen – Deelname aan ons SAR-programma en mee op de jaarlijkse winterreis MET WIE JE WERKT Je komt in het serviceteam van Lars Steverink, Head of Service. Hij startte vijf jaar geleden bij DeWarmte toen het bedrijf uit vier mensen bestond en bouwde de serviceorganisatie op. Je werkt dagelijks samen met de servicecoördinatie in Den Haag die je route plant, met het magazijn in Utrecht en met de engineers die de warmtepompen ontwerpen. HOE HET GAAT We nemen op dit moment ongeveer vier mensen per maand aan, en de teams die we nu bouwen moeten staan voor de piek aan het eind van het jaar. Reageer je deze week, dan zit je er nog bij. Bel of app Marvin op 06 1111 9775, of stuur je cv. Een motivatiebrief hoeft niet. Kennismaking van een half uur. Daarna kom je langs, ook in Utrecht waar de warmtepompen in elkaar worden gezet en getest. Binnen vijf werkdagen weet je waar je staat. Compensation: €3K – €5K per month • €3K – €5K per month Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Requests may include user migrations, de-duplication, Renewal Manager ownership changes, compensation exceptions, and Salesforce or data issues.</li> <li>Raise the operating standard in your domain by documenting processes, mentoring others on how the renewal motion works, and contributing to broader Revenue Operations initiatives that need the renewals perspective.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in Renewals Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, management consulting, strategy, or a similar analytical and problem-solving role, with ownership of operational improvements and cross-functional initiatives.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with both consumption and subscription renewal motions, including renewal forecasting, retention reporting, and the contractual and process mechanics that govern how renewals close.</li> <li>Strong critical thinking and structured problem-solving skills. You understand how changes in one part of the go-to-market motion affect others, including how CRM, subscription or entitlement records, quoting, and billing relate to one another, and you design solutions accordingly.</li> <li>Sound commercial judgment and an understanding of renewal complexity, including co-terming, amendments, expansions, downgrades, price changes, multiyear agreements, auto-renewals, procurement requirements, and approval policies.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. In GitLab's all-remote, values-driven environment, documentation, iteration, and cross-functional partnership are core to how you'll work.</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. You'll contribute to that mission by making testing and coverage insights more useful across the software development lifecycle.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define and communicate the Test & Code Coverage product vision, strategy, and outcome-focused roadmap, from discovery through a minimum viable product, beta, launch, and continued iteration.</li> <li>Identify customer problems across pipeline failure diagnosis, test automation, test optimization, code coverage, and recovery. Build the case for investment, prioritize foundational and customer-facing work, and reshape or stop initiatives that aren't creating value.</li> <li>Work with Engineering to understand pipeline failures caused by flaky tests, testing gaps, environment issues, configuration problems, and coverage blind spots. Connect code changes, tests, pipeline behavior, historical patterns, and risk to help developers find a diagnosis and an actionable next step.</li> <li>Work directly with customers to understand how they author, maintain, select, prioritize, and debug tests. Connect test selection, test impact analysis, code coverage, and pipeline intelligence to reduce flaky tests, shorten feedback loops, and focus testing effort where it lowers the most risk.</li> <li>Partner with Engineering and Design to prototype agent-driven workflows for failure diagnosis, test authoring and repair, optimization, coverage analysis, and recovery. Make actions reviewable through evidence, confidence, human approval, and safe paths to propose code changes and merge requests. Use AI tools in your own product work to investigate problems, explore code and data, prototype concepts, and accelerate learning.</li> <li>Define and measure outcomes such as time to diagnose, time to recover, failure recurrence, test signal quality, and developer confidence. Validate problems and solutions with customers and learn from production usage.</li> <li>Partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Quality, Developer Experience, Customer Success, Support, and Product Marketing to connect testing insights with code review, pipelines, and release decisions. Turn customer evidence into clear narratives that support adoption and future investment.</li> <li>Lead through clear written communication, prioritization, and product judgment. Influence senior stakeholders, establish repeatable discovery and measurement practices, and mentor other product managers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning complex technical products, platforms, or developer workflows at Staff, Senior Staff, Principal, or equivalent scope, including building a new product or capability from initial validation through launch and adoption.</li> <li>Strong product fundamentals in customer discovery, problem framing, prioritization, roadmap development, outcome measurement, and iterative delivery.</li> <li>Technical fluency in one or more relevant areas, such as software testing, test automation, code coverage, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), developer tools, DevOps, developer experience, quality engineering, or software delivery.</li> <li>An understanding of how engineering teams build, test, review, and ship software, and the ability to work with engineers on test architecture, pipeline behavior, code changes, data, integrations, reliability, and scale.</li> <li>Experience diagnosing technical problems and turning complex, noisy signals into clear user experiences and actionable workflows.</li> <li>Experience exploring AI or agent-driven solutions for developer workflows, with the judgment to distinguish useful automation from unsafe or low-confidence actions.</li> <li>Experience using customer conversations to understand problems and inform product decisions, communicating clearly in writing and conversation, and influencing across functions with shared ownership. You can work directly with developers, quality engineers, platform teams, engineering leaders, and executives, and move between strategy and implementation detail.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Our work brings together Product, Engineering, and Design, with input from Quality, Developer Experience, Customer Success, Support, and Product Marketing. We work directly with developers, quality engineers, and engineering leaders to understand their testing practices, validate ideas, and learn from how they use the product.</p> <p>We give Engineering and Design clear customer context and room to shape solutions. Our decisions draw on customer evidence and measurable outcomes, and we revisit approaches that aren't creating value. You'll contribute to how we discover problems, prioritize work, and measure progress, as well as sharing product management practices with other product managers.</p> <p>As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, we collaborate asynchronously across regions. Our work emphasizes transparency, written communication, and clear decision-making.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Principal Product Manager, Orbit
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As Principal Product Manager, Orbit, you'll define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for GitLab's software lifecycle context graph. Orbit connects source code and software development lifecycle data into a structured map of systems, relationships, dependencies, and ownership. You'll help engineers, software leaders, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents understand how teams build software and how changes affect the systems around it.</p> <p>You'll shape Orbit from its underlying graph model and query experiences through customer value, pricing, packaging, launch, and adoption. This role combines technical product leadership with building a business around software lifecycle context. You'll balance foundational platform work with near-term customer needs, working directly with technical customers and senior Engineering and Design leaders.</p> <p>You'll join Anand Ahire's product organization and partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success, including the teams building GitLab Duo and the broader AI-powered development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define Orbit's multi-year vision and roadmap across graph models and ontology, ingestion and indexing, query and retrieval, developer and agent interfaces, governance, and enterprise readiness. Shape how Orbit works across GitLab.com, Self-Managed, Dedicated, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, MCP-based external agents, APIs, and developer tooling.</li> <li>Turn complex platform opportunities into customer problems, measurable outcomes, and investment decisions. Use evidence to decide where to invest, iterate, partner, or stop.</li> <li>Partner with Engineering and Design on architecture and implementation tradeoffs across graph data models, indexing, query systems, application programming interfaces (APIs), Model Context Protocol (MCP), authorization, and scale.</li> <li>Use AI tools such as Claude Code and GitLab to investigate problems, explore code and data, prototype concepts, and create or review merge requests when that's the fastest way to learn.</li> <li>Lead discovery with developers, engineering leaders, platform teams, security teams, and technical executives to validate needs around dependencies, ownership, change impact, vulnerability exposure, pipeline health, and software delivery risk. Build repeatable feedback into roadmap decisions and help customers understand the value of connected graph context over disconnected searches or API calls.</li> <li>Define target customers, priority use cases, differentiated value, and the path to product-market fit. Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Pricing, and Finance on positioning, packaging, pricing, launch, adoption, and expansion.</li> <li>Develop business cases and track adoption, retention, usage, customer value, and revenue outcomes. Support executive briefings, analyst conversations, customer workshops, and field enablement.</li> <li>Align teams and executive leaders around clear recommendations and tradeoffs without relying on direct authority. Mentor other product managers, share practical frameworks, and represent GitLab's product vision in customer and industry conversations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning complex technical products or platforms at Staff, Principal, or equivalent scope, with a track record of defining vision and roadmaps across multiple teams.</li> <li>Deep technical fluency in one or more relevant areas, such as developer tools, DevOps, software delivery, data platforms, distributed systems, knowledge graphs, search, APIs, AI infrastructure, or agentic systems.</li> <li>The ability to work credibly with engineers on architecture, data models, APIs, scale, reliability, and security.</li> <li>Business judgment and experience in market assessment, product strategy, pricing, packaging, business cases, or commercialization of technical products.</li> <li>Experience taking a product, platform, or category from early concept through launch, customer adoption, and iteration.</li> <li>A customer-first approach and the ability to build trusted relationships with technical practitioners, engineering leaders, architects, and executives.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, with experience explaining complex ideas, influencing across functions, and resolving competing priorities in ambiguous work.</li> <li>Practical experience using AI tools in product work, including exploring code and data, prototyping workflows, and creating or reviewing merge requests. You take ownership, learn quickly, and move between strategy and implementation detail.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>In GitLab's Analytics organization, we focus on making Orbit's context available through GitLab experiences, developer tools, MCP, APIs, and the command-line interface (CLI).</p> <p>Our challenge is to turn complex, connected data into useful, trustworthy context for engineers and agents. You'll work with engineering and cross-functional partners who value technical rigor, clear product thinking, rapid learning, and direct customer contact. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, we collaborate asynchronously across regions, with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decisions.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only.
