title: Senior Backend Engineer – Platform & Reliability
description: About Maesn Want to join a growing European startup early and be part of an epic journey? At Maesn we build software for other software companies. We provide an integration platform that lets B2B software companies add integrations to their platforms in hours and days instead of weeks and months. Our customers love us because we are innovative, quick, friendly and provide integrations for systems that others dare not touch. We are a young dynamic SaaS Startup born in Düsseldorf who believe in working hard and having fun while doing it. You will have the chance to work on all parts of our technology stack and in close collaboration with our customers, to understand their needs and get direct feedback on the changes you ship. The role Our platform sits between our customers and dozens of third-party accounting and ERP systems. That makes reliability part of our product. When a call is slow or fails, our customers need to know why, and so do we. You’ll be the senior engineer who owns how our platform runs in production, and you’ll keep building the product alongside the team. You’ll work directly with our CTO, Lennart Svensson, and the wider founder team. What you will do Own our Azure infrastructure end-to-end You know every service, how it’s deployed and what it costs. You’ll tighten what’s there and codify what isn’t. As we scale, you’ll keep the architecture simple: we run on managed services and plan to keep it that way. Bring real observability to the platform Metrics, logs, traces and alerts, across our services and the third-party APIs we call. You’ll define what “healthy” means, build the dashboards, and set up alerting and on-call so we catch problems before our clients do. When a mysterious timeout appears, you’re the one who can trace it to its source. Raise the bar on security and reliability Fintechs trust us with sensitive financial data. You’ll harden the platform, make sure we can deliver on incident response and SLAs, and keep us audit-ready as customers ask for certifications like SOC 2 or ISO 27001. Build product and level up the team You’ll ship features and integrations with the rest of the engineering team. You’ll also be the go-to person for production debugging, and you’ll mentor our engineers so the whole team gets better at running what we build. What you bring Experience: 5+ years building and running backend services in production, including real ownership of infrastructure, deployments and incidents. Production debugging: You’ve chased down latency spikes, timeouts and flaky dependencies, and you know how to go from “something is slow” to the root cause. Azure: Solid hands-on experience running production workloads on Azure. Observability: Experience instrumenting services with tracing, structured logging and metrics, ideally with OpenTelemetry or similar. Infrastructure-as-code mindset: You codify infrastructure rather than clicking through consoles. Security by default: You think about secrets, access management, and compliance as part of the work, not as an afterthought. Backend skills: You’re comfortable writing production code in TypeScript/Node.js and enjoy shipping features, not only keeping the lights on. Pragmatism and mentoring: You pick the simplest setup that works. You enjoy helping less experienced engineers grow, and you’re excited to set the standards for how we run our platform. What we offer First-hand experience building a fast-growing tech startup Kind teammates and great collaborative atmosphere Steep learning curve and a varied job with interesting projects and technologies Work fully remote or in our office in Düsseldorf Fun offsites where the team gets together to work and play One-time allowance for improving your home office Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership Laptop and work equipment 30 days of PTO + Local holidays Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Commercial Legal Counsel
description: Thank you for considering Tailscale . If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic! About Tailscale Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital. About the Role We are hiring a Commercial Legal Counsel to lead day-to-day commercial legal support as Tailscale continues to grow. You will partner closely with Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Security, Product, and Operations to help the company close business, manage risk, and build contracting practices that scale. This role reports to the Head of Legal. The strongest candidate may be an experienced commercial counsel ready for broader ownership, a senior counsel who has led complex transactions and programs, or a commercial legal leader who can shape the function while remaining hands-on. Key Responsibilities Own and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including enterprise customer, vendor, partner, marketplace, technology, data protection, and confidentiality agreements. Advise Sales and other go-to-market teams on deal structure, contracting strategy, risk, and escalation paths. Translate legal issues into clear options and recommendations that help teams make timely decisions. Build and improve templates, playbooks, fallback positions, approval thresholds, intake processes, and self-service resources. Partner with Security, Privacy, Product, and Engineering on customer commitments involving data, security, product functionality, integrations, artificial intelligence, and emerging technologies. Work with Finance and Revenue Operations on pricing terms, revenue considerations, procurement, insurance, and other commercial matters. Support international transactions and coordinate with outside counsel when local or specialized expertise is needed. Identify patterns in negotiations and use data to improve cycle time, consistency, and the experience of customers and internal teams. Contribute to other legal priorities as the company and legal function evolve. What We Are Looking For A law degree and active membership in at least one applicable bar or equivalent authorization to practice law. Meaningful experience advising technology companies on commercial transactions, including in-house experience or equivalent experience working closely with technology clients. Experience helping a legal function, contracting program, or business process scale in a startup or high-growth environment. Strong judgment and the ability to distinguish material business risk from issues that can be addressed through practical guardrails. A record of leading negotiations with sophisticated customers, partners, vendors, or counterparties. Clear, concise communication and the ability to build trust across Legal, Sales, Finance, Security, Product, and executive teams. Comfort working independently, prioritizing competing demands, and making progress with incomplete information. A collaborative approach that creates appropriate ownership and avoids making Legal an unnecessary bottleneck. Nice to Have Commercial work involving developer tools, cloud infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, software as a service, or open-source products. Experience with enterprise sales, product-led growth, channel or technology partnerships, marketplaces, integrations, or application programming interfaces. Familiarity with privacy, data protection, security, artificial intelligence, intellectual property, or product counseling issues that arise in technology transactions. Experience supporting global customers or coordinating advice across multiple jurisdictions. Experience selecting or implementing contract lifecycle management tools, workflow automation, or commercial legal metrics. Experience mentoring colleagues or helping define the structure and priorities of a growing commercial legal capability. As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set. CAN Pay Range $250,580—$313,560 CAD What We Offer An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life. A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles). Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family! Remote first company —most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description. Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation. Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration. Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. Paid parental leave program . We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents). Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter. Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people. Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness .

title: Performance Creative Manager
description: About Solace Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes. We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly. Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way. Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here . About the Role As the Performance Creative Manager at Solace, you'll build and lead the creative engine behind an eight-figure monthly paid media program. You'll craft a performance creative system — channel-dedicated pods of creative strategists, designers, and video editors working alongside media buyers across our full stack of acquisition channels — and own creative-driven CPA improvement across all of it. This is a builder's role for someone who speaks both craft and performance fluently: you'll define the testing frameworks, develop the team, negotiate the brand guardrails, and create the systems that turn creative production into a compounding performance advantage. What You'll Own Build, hire, and mentor the performance creative organization — creative strategists, designers, video editors, and creative operations — embedded in channel pods alongside media buyers across Meta, TikTok/AppLovin, and YouTube. Own creative-driven CPA improvement across all pods. Define and run the creative testing framework: concept, variant, and iteration definitions; weekly production quotas per pod; hit-rate targets; and the kill/iterate/scale decision system. Own the creative analytics foundation: naming conventions and tagging taxonomy that make winning patterns searchable, measurable, and repeatable across channels. Stand up and govern the content library — raw UGC and branded shoot footage, finished-asset archive with performance data, and the approved-claims and copy library — as the infrastructure layer for pod velocity. Own the shoot roadmap and external creator/contractor budget: quarterly branded production planning, the UGC creator program, and the production partner ecosystem. Negotiate and own the brand guardrails system — codified rules that let pods ship at velocity inside clear boundaries, with defined review lanes for net-new territory. Own regulatory and legal compliance systems for creative: the approved-claims library and review-lane process, built with legal, appropriate to a healthcare environment. Run the cross-pod creative review cadence so learnings transfer between channels — a winning Meta hook becomes a TikTok hypothesis becomes a CTV script. What Success Looks Like A creative organization that ships winning ads on a weekly cadence — on brand, compliant, channel-native, and relentlessly tested — where creative is the growth lever: rising hit rates, falling CPAs, and a library of compounding creative intelligence. Who You Are A builder who has stood up teams, systems, and processes from scratch — and knows the difference between an org chart and an operating system. A leader fluent in both creative craft and performance data; you can give an editor frame-level feedback and defend a testing budget in the same meeting. A systems thinker who believes velocity comes from infrastructure — taxonomies, libraries, briefs, and cadences — not heroics. Excited to contribute hands-on in a high-growth, mission-driven startup. What You Bring to the Table Direct experience managing creative on $50M+/year in paid media spend. Proven track record building and managing creative teams (strategists, designers, editors) of 5+ people, ideally in a pod or embedded model. Deep fluency in creative testing at scale: concept/variant frameworks, hit-rate measurement, creative fatigue diagnosis, and iteration systems on Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. Experience running UGC creator programs and branded production — briefing, shoot planning, usage rights, and turning raw footage into high-velocity variant production. Strong command of creative analytics: tagging taxonomies, creative reporting, and connecting asset-level data to CPA outcomes. Experience partnering with brand and legal teams to build guardrails and claims-review systems that protect the brand without killing velocity. Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. A bias for action — you move fast, make sound decisions, and thrive under tight timelines. Bonus: experience in healthcare or other regulated industries, a marketplace business, or a fast-paced startup environment. Applicants must be based in the United States. Up for the Challenge? We look forward to meeting you. Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Solace Health will NEVER request bank details or offer employment without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com . Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

title: Senior GTM Systems & AI Specialist

Evaluate, implement, and optimize GTM technologies with a focus on business impact, scalability, usability, and reducing operational complexity. HubSpot & Marketing Technology Serve as the primary technical owner and administrator of HubSpot, including workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring and routing, forms, campaign infrastructure, attribution configuration, integrations, automation, and data synchronization with Salesforce. Maintain alignment between Salesforce and HubSpot data models, lifecycle definitions, routing logic, campaign data, and reporting requirements. Data, Enrichment & GTM Signals Own the technical infrastructure supporting GTM data quality and enrichment, including enrichment providers, field mapping, matching logic, deduplication, normalization, data governance, and ongoing monitoring. Design and maintain reliable enrichment and data orchestration workflows that ensure GTM teams have accurate, complete, and actionable account and contact data. Build scalable processes for activating intent signals, engagement data, enrichment signals, and buying triggers across GTM systems. Proactively monitor data and integration health, identify gaps or failures, and implement solutions that improve data accuracy, coverage, reliability, and usability. Customer Success Technology Support the administration and integration of Customer Success platforms and the data infrastructure supporting the post-sale customer lifecycle. Partner with Revenue Operations and Customer Success to enable processes such as customer health scoring, segmentation, account planning, renewals, expansion, churn risk, and lifecycle management. Ensure customer and commercial data flows reliably across Salesforce, Customer Success platforms, and the broader GTM ecosystem. Automation, AI & Innovation Identify, design, and implement opportunities to automate repetitive GTM workflows across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations. Build scalable workflow automation using native platform capabilities, APIs, webhooks, and tools such as n8n, Zapier, or similar technologies. Evaluate and implement practical AI-powered solutions that improve GTM productivity, research, data quality, prioritization, customer insights, or operational efficiency. Build and experiment with AI-enabled workflows and agents where they can deliver measurable business value. Stay current on emerging GTM and AI technologies and proactively recommend opportunities to improve how our revenue organization operates. Systems Governance & Operational Excellence Own system health, integrations, permissions, release management, documentation, and technical governance across the GTM technology ecosystem. Establish monitoring and controls to proactively identify integration failures, data issues, workflow errors, and system risks. Maintain clear documentation of architecture, integrations, workflows, business rules, and system dependencies to support scalability and business continuity. Own technical initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization. You Must Have 7+ years of experience in GTM Systems, Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, Salesforce Administration, GTM Engineering, or a related field within B2B SaaS. Advanced hands-on Salesforce administration expertise, including Flows, automation, permissions, integrations, data architecture, reporting, dashboards, and governance. Advanced hands-on HubSpot administration expertise, including workflows, lifecycle management, lead scoring and routing, forms, campaigns, attribution, automation, integrations, and reporting. Experience serving as a primary technical owner of Salesforce and HubSpot, including managing the integration and data flow between the two platforms. Strong understanding of the end-to-end B2B SaaS GTM lifecycle across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, with the ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions. Strong experience with GTM data enrichment and governance, including enrichment providers, matching and mapping logic, deduplication, normalization, data quality monitoring, and CRM data management. Experience designing and maintaining cross-platform integrations using APIs, webhooks, middleware, or workflow automation platforms. Experience building scalable workflow automation using native GTM platforms and tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar technologies. Experience administering or integrating Customer Success platforms and supporting post-sale customer data and workflows. Experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows, with an understanding of where AI can create meaningful business value and where traditional automation is the better solution. Demonstrated ability to independently own business-critical GTM systems, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive technical initiatives from requirements through deployment. Strong communication and partnership skills, with the ability to work effectively with Revenue Operations, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Analytics, and technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience with GTM technologies such as Apollo, Clay, LeanData, ZoomInfo, 6sense, Gong, Outreach, Qualified, Clari, UserGems, Planhat, or similar platforms. Experience designing signal-based GTM workflows using intent, engagement, enrichment, product, or customer data. Experience building or deploying AI-powered workflows or agents within GTM systems. Working knowledge of SQL, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar technologies used to extend and automate GTM systems. Experience supporting a scaling SaaS organization through systems transformation, technology consolidation, or process redesign. Why You Should Join Us Grow in a passionate, rapidly expanding industry operating at the forefront of the Pentesting industry Work directly with experienced senior leaders with ongoing mentorship opportunities Earn competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan Save for the future with a 401(k) program (US) or pension (EU) Benefit from medical, dental, vision and life insurance (US) or statutory healthcare (EU) Leverage stipends for: Wellness Work-from-home equipment & wifi Learning & development Make the most of our flexible, generous paid time off and paid parental leave Pay Range Disclosure (For US openings only) Cobalt is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this role is ($135,000 - $160,000) + equity + benefits. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. The salary range may differ in other states and may be impacted by proximity to major metropolitan cities. It is the Company's policy to prohibit discrimination in any employment opportunity (including but not limited to recruitment, employment, promotion, salary increases, benefits, termination and all other terms and conditions of employment) based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, pregnancy, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical/mental disability, medical condition, marital/domestic partner status, military and veteran status, height, weight or any other such characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. The Company is committed to complying with all applicable laws and providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all persons involved in the operations of the Company regardless of where the employee is located and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company. title: Technical Program Manager
description: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. About the Role As a Technical Program Manager at Able, you'll drive the execution of AI and software programs across engineering, product, and partner teams. You'll keep work moving — owning timelines, dependencies, and communication for one or more programs — while working closely with senior TPMs and the hiring manager on the harder tradeoff calls. This is a technical role: you should be comfortable following a system design discussion, understanding the dependencies between services and teams, and asking the right questions when an estimate or integration doesn't line up. You don't need to architect the system yourself, but you do need to understand enough of how it's built to keep delivery on track and spot risk early. You'll thrive here if you're organized, proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and eager to grow your technical depth in a fast-moving, AI-native delivery environment. What We’re Looking For Day-to-Day Responsibilities Program Execution Drive one or more AI and software delivery programs through planning, execution, and launch. Own program schedules, execution plans, and cross-functional alignment to ensure delivery commitments are met. Maintain roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, and status; keep plans current as priorities shift. Contribute to design and planning discussions — understand the technical scope well enough to track it accurately. Engineering Coordination & Delivery Coordinate work across backend, frontend, ML/AI, and data workstreams, keeping handoffs and interfaces clear. Identify and escalate technical blockers, dependencies, and integration gaps before they slip the schedule. Track and report program health using sprint progress, milestones, delivery metrics, risks, dependencies, and launch readiness indicators and keep them visible to the team. Risk & Communication Track risks and dependencies; flag issues early and help drive them to resolution with engineering leads. Communicate clear, accurate program status to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Keep documentation, action items, and decisions organized and accessible. Stakeholder Support Support partner and stakeholder communication alongside senior TPMs. Translate program plans into clear updates and help keep business goals and technical execution aligned. Contribute to improving team rituals, documentation, and delivery processes. Drive delivery while helping maintain a high technical bar across the team. Required Skills & Experience 3–5 years in Technical Program Management, project coordination, or a related cross-functional role on software teams. Able to engage in technical discussions, read architecture diagrams and tickets, ask clarifying questions, and identify execution risks. Working familiarity with modern software development: APIs, cloud basics, version control, CI/CD, and Agile delivery. Baseline understanding of AI/ML product concepts — LLMs, generative AI, and how AI features move from prototype toward production. Track record keeping software programs organized and on track, ideally in startup or consulting environments. Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve, ambiguity is common, and processes are still being developed. Solid risk and dependency tracking; able to surface issues early and clearly. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Strong English verbal and written communication. Hands-on experience with Agile methodologies and modern collaboration tools. Nice to Have Exposure to AI systems — RAG, agentic workflows, vector databases, or prompt/eval workflows. Experience supporting AI, ML, or data-driven product delivery. Background in technical consulting or client-facing project work. A technical foundation in software engineering, computer science, or a related field. Experience with Jira, Linear, Notion, Asana, or similar tools. Scrum Master or Agile certifications. What Success Looks Like Programs stay organized and on track, with clear status and dependencies always visible. Blockers and risks are surfaced early and escalated to the right people. Engineering and stakeholder communication is timely, accurate, and clear. The TPM grows in technical depth and progressively takes on more program ownership. Delivery processes and documentation improve through consistent, reliable execution. Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect: To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed. Payments made in USD. 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years. Wellness + Remote Stipend AI Voucher About Able Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth. We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster. Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you. Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

title: Senior Software Engineer, Canvas Core

Your role will be to reduce platform complexity, improve the quality and speed of Canvas development, and help teams ship high-quality editor experiences quickly and safely. Senior Engineers at Mural lead by example through strong technical execution, thoughtful design, high-quality implementation, and collaborative problem-solving. title: Senior Decision Scientist

Identify and pursue high-value opportunities to improve product adoption, customer engagement, and revenue growth using advanced analytical and statistical methods. Lead experimentation and causal analysis. Design and execute rigorous A/B tests and causal inference studies to evaluate the impact of new product features, pricing strategies, and go-to-market initiatives. Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs. Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth The technology and tools you need to do your best work Motivosity employee recognition program A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. title: Senior Software Engineer, Admin & IAM

We also own the enterprise administration experience; the configuration and controls that company and workspace admins use to manage their organizations and users. By providing secure, clear, and intuitive controls for users and administrators, we help organizations adopt Mural quickly and collaborate with confidence. YOUR MISSION As a Senior Software Engineer on the Admin & IAM team, you will design and ship these capabilities end-to-end, from identity primitives like the permission model and authentication flows to the admin surfaces enterprise customers use every day. Senior Engineers on Admin & IAM own complex technical initiatives, influence platform and security best practices, and collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Infrastructure to deliver secure experiences that feel simple and intuitive. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work with a small, focused team in a remote-first environment, with the option to work from our Buenos Aires office. WHAT YOU'LL DO Build and evolve core identity and access systems that power authentication & authorization, SSO, user provisioning, session management, and permissions across Mural Build and evolve the enterprise administration experience, including company and workspace configuration, user and content administration, billing, and internal admin tooling Collaborate with cross-functional partners to design and ship secure, intuitive access and administration experiences for users and administrators Prototype, implement, and maintain Admin & IAM platform features, contributing as a technical title: Senior Software Engineer (Full-Stack, JavaScript)
description: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Partner with product and design to shape solutions from idea to implementation. Write and review code with a focus on quality, performance, and maintainability. Experience producing clear architecture documentation and guiding implementation. Strong ownership with the ability to drive problems end-to-end. title: Business Development Executive (Tasman)
description: About Halter At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund , Bessemer Venture Partners , BOND, DCVC , Blackbird , Promus Ventures , Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures . To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram . About the role: As a Business Development Executive at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction within the dairy industry. In this role, you will prioritise daily efforts that optimise growth performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and other regional sales teams, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of farmers. Your contributions will directly support Halter’s mission to support 50% of the world's habitable landmass to be more productive and sustainable. We are searching for a driven hunter with a strong track record to lead Halter’s expansion in the Tasman market. This is an opportunity to positively disrupt an industry and pioneer groundbreaking change on some of the highest-performing dairy farms. You will be leading the Tasman's expansion for one of the world’s fastest-growing companies by helping equip farms with Halter technology that will transform the way they farm to become leaders in productivity and sustainability. You will be working closely with a passionate Customer team on the ground in the area and backed by a team of exceptional people at Halter’s Auckland HQ, to ensure this is the best job you’ll ever have. This role can be based anywhere in the Tasman region, ideally in Nelson. Applicant must live within the region. Travel is required to meet with farmers daily. Who we're looking for: A deep passion for helping farmers succeed. Experience in farm systems or within the agricultural sector. A hunter. Someone who is driven to exceed goals in a sales role. Experience in growing new business, owning the end-to-end sales cycle from lead generation to close. Passion and enthusiastic people. Attitude and potential are extremely important to us. A phenomenal attitude and a team player with the ability to consistently overcome challenges. A Hunter with a never-say-never attitude. A deep passion for helping farmers succeed. A phenomenal attitude and a team player with the ability to consistently overcome challenges. The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment with a high degree of autonomy. A hunger for success and personal growth to be able to evolve quickly alongside a world-class sales team. What your day could look like: On-farm sales meetings: Understanding the needs and problems of your prospects then clearly communicating functionality, benefits and highlighting value relative to each farming operation. Prospecting: Building and growing a pipeline of quality farms fit for Halter, while continuously reducing sales cycle times. Managing newly sourced and inbound leads through the initial stages of the pipeline including screening and qualifying. Networking: Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand. Forecasting: Working with the Business Development Manager to enable monthly and quarterly forecasting of revenue. Growth initiatives: Working with the Business Development Manager to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient, and more predictable as the company scales. Join our team Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit! If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch! Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram . Why our team loves working at Halter: Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations. Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems. You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund. This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email). Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed. Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta .ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

title: Senior Manager, Professional Services
description: Joining Collibra ’s Professional Services team As Senior Manager, Professional Services, you will play an integral role within Collibra, comprehensively aligned with Regional Sales counterparts, Account Teams, Customer Engineers, Partner Teams, and Services Delivery to drive services sales, delivery and customer success. You will lead services sales and delivery, managing cross-functional collaboration, ensuring aligned and value-based outcomes for Collibra customers. Senior Manager of Professional Services at Collibra are responsible for Drive PS sales and delivery responsibility: Own a quota for Professional Services bookings and support delivery execution, assisting customers with journey design, implementation decisions, and services solutions. Personnel and team management: Lead and strategically manage a dedicated team of Architects and Engagement Managers, overseeing performance, career development, and utilization. New logo and stand-alone services: Partner with Account Executives to craft compelling services proposals and identify stand-alone opportunities within existing accounts (advisory, implementation, enablement, and optimization). Customer engagement and delivery quality: Act as a trusted advisor, articulating how services solve business challenges, improve Collibra adoption, and ensure value-based outcomes across all customer engagements. Implementation Partner Network Development: Collaborate with regional Collibra Partner Accounts Team to identify, qualify and establish viable in-region implementation partners to be leveraged for customer referral and services subcontracting purposes. Assist with onboarding these partners if not already part of our Preferred Partner program. Develop solutions that embed these partner resources into the proposed delivery model approach. Pipeline and issue management: Build and maintain a healthy pipeline, forecast accurately, and collaborate across functional teams (CE, Sales, Product, Support) to resolve escalations and meet targets. Talent development and market insights: Develop team skills, onboard new members, and stay informed on SaaS industry trends and competitive offerings to refine sales and delivery strategies. You have Bachelor's Degree at minimum with 10+ years of relevant working experience in consulting, Professional Services sales, solution sales, and services delivery. Proven track record of success in meeting or exceeding quota and building/leading high-performing professional services teams. Experience scoping, pricing, negotiating, and closing SOWs for complex enterprise organizations. Domain expertise in AI transformation, data governance, data management, and data quality. Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows. Strong executive presence and skill in navigating enterprise procurement and joint software/services sales engagements. You are Customer-Focused Advocate: Commercially minded and passionate about customer success, adoption, and driving value-based outcomes. Collaborative Leader: Skilled at building relationships and fostering strong cross-functional partnerships across internal and external stakeholders with the Professional Services team. Exceptional Communicator: Able to translate business challenges into service solutions with clear, influential written and verbal communication. Proactive & Agile: Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments with strong problem-solving skills and continuous improvement focus. Inspirational Role Model: Self-motivated, organized, accountable, and dedicated to setting a high standard and inspiring trust. title: Detection & Response Engineer
description: About Nebius : Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. Detection and Response The Detection and Response team is responsible for detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response across Nebius Cloud. Its goal is to improve and maintain Nebius's security monitoring capabilities, as well as to build and maintain an end-to-end Security Incident Response program - people, processes, and tools. The Role We're hiring a Detection & Response Engineer to build and run our D&R capability from the ground up. You'll work on detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response functions across Nebius Cloud. You'll be responsible for detection development, handling complex security incidents, forensics, and shaping the D&R strategy. What you’ll do Detection development: maintain low false-positive and false-negative rates. Work closely with alerts consumers (20+ teams) to keep noise low and signal high, ensuring they can act quickly without missing genuine threats. Architect and operate detection coverage across our cloud and bare-metal environments Build and extend our internal D&R tools and pipelines - onboard new logs, build and automate response runbooks. Integrate threat intelligence into detection logic and IR playbooks, tracking adversary TTPs relevant to Cloud infrastructure Lead incident response end-to-end: scoping, containment, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews and controlling critical action items are closed to prevent future possible incidents. Partner with Compliance and Engineering teams to detect real threats while meeting the needs of both engineers and regulators. Define and report on D&R metrics: MTTD, MTTR, detection coverage, false positive rates, etc. Build and maintain Security Incident Response program: people, processes, tools. Build tools, runbooks, and on-call processes that scale as the company grows. What we look for 6+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response. Deep hands-on experience with cloud-native environments (Kubernetes, Linux workloads, container-based infrastructure). Strong detection engineering skills: writing and tuning rules/detections in SIEM platforms (e.g., Chronicle, Splunk, Elastic) and SQL. Experience building or operating SOAR workflows and automating response at scale (ideally with Golang and Temporal). Working knowledge of threat intelligence frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, Pyramid of Pain, Kill Chain) and how to operationalize them in detections. Solid IR fundamentals: memory forensics, log analysis, network traffic analysis, and post-incident reporting. Stakeholder management: able to coordinate across engineers, compliance, legal, executives during active incident phase. Serve as the primary owner and driver for complex changes, as a result of incidents post-mortem. Nice to have Experience with AI/ML and GPU clusters related threats. Familiarity with eBPF-based detection or runtime security tooling (Falco, Tetragon). Background in threat hunting. Why this role at Nebius Build D&R at a company scaling from startup to global infrastructure provider in real time. Ability to evolve our internal D&R platform into a new cloud security product, delivering novel security observability for a range of neocloud customers - from big tech to AI startups. title: Senior Product Manager, Mobile
description: Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser, and Pocket, a service for keeping up with the best content online. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: We’re looking for a hands-on Mobile Product Manager with a primary focus on Firefox for iOS, while also contributing across mobile (including Android). This role is about building a better browser, turning downloads into loyal users, and creating experiences that truly stand out. If you’ve shipped mobile apps, obsess over details that improve everyday use, and love turning user insights into real improvements, this is a great opportunity to drive impact at Firefox. What you’ll do: Build a fundamentally better browser experience: fix bugs, refine UI and navigation, improve downloads, menus, performance, and all the small details that make Firefox noticeably better for users who care about privacy, quality and reliability. Drive strong activation and retention: focus on the new-user journey, quickly hooking people after they install the app, understanding where they drop off, and relentlessly optimizing the funnel through data, testing and iteration. Deliver differentiating features and experiences that make Firefox stickier for key user groups, the kinds of things others can’t or won’t build. Work closely with engineers, designers, data science and TPMs to ship high-impact improvements while balancing user needs, technical constraints, privacy and performance goals. Stay deeply connected to real users: track App Store trends and discussions, test apps hands-on, analyze reviews and analytics, and turn those insights into concrete enhancements for Firefox on iOS and Android. Monitor app health in App Store Connect and Google Play Console (crashes, ANRs, ratings) and support acquisition/retention efforts through ASO, store listings and growth experiments. Adapt and optimize Firefox for global markets (Europe, Japan, Asia etc.), keeping cultural differences and local realities like data constraints in mind. What you'll bring: Proven Shipping Experience: Hands-on experience launching or managing apps on the iOS App Store and/or Google Play Store, with clear impact on user experience and metrics. Execution Focus: A strong track record of delivering features and improvements under deadlines through effective collaboration with engineering, design and cross-functional partners. Mobile & Browser Fluency: Deep understanding of iOS (and ideally Android) ecosystems, app store policies and web browser technologies, with genuine passion for what makes a great browsing experience. Data-Driven Iteration: Comfort using analytics, funnels, A/B testing and user feedback to improve activation, retention and overall product quality. User Obsession: Natural habit of studying apps, following trends on platforms like X/Twitter and Reddit, and testing experiences yourself to uncover opportunities. Global & Growth Mindset: Interest or experience growing products in international markets with sensitivity to local user needs. Bonus: Experience with mobile browsers or privacy-focused products. History of meaningfully scaling an app’s user base. Currently maintaining your own side project or app on the App Store or Google Play. What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly well-being stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions. title: Principal Product Manager Strategic Initiatives
description: OUR MISSION We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond. Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers. As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer. Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters. WHAT YOU'LL DO We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to set the product direction for new, zero-to-one initiatives focused on applying AI to make better care decisions in oncology â helping people receive the right, evidence-based treatment at the moment it matters. Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform. This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for a product leader who can operate at both the strategic and implementation levels â moving fluidly between learning from users, defining product direction, partnering with engineering and other stakeholders to shape solutions , and driving execution to launch. You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows. Additionally, you will: Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally Build the workflow tooling and decision support surfaces clinicians and care teams need to act on AI recommendations Own the evaluations, guardrails, and observability standards to ensure recommendations are accurate, safe, and trusted across, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health-plan stakeholders Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations Communicate tradeoffs and profess clearly to senior clinical, engineering, and business stakeholders Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently WHAT YOU'VE DONE 6+ years of product management experience, including leading zero-to-one or early-stage initiatives when the problem, requirements, and path forward were not fully defined You have healthcare experience, ideally building workflow, data, or integration products for enterprise contexts Youâre comfortable with ambiguity and defining a path forward for yourself and others You have hands-on experience building or shipping AI/LLM-powered products You communicate clearly and build alignment across engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders You like to operate close to the technical details, such as data models, edge cases, evaluations, and impacts of implementation Nice to haves: Experience in oncology, serious illness / palliative care, or chronic condition management Hands-on experience shipping AI/LLM-powered product features, including safety guardrails, evaluation, and quality measurement OUR VALUES At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we chooseâor donât choose. Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Thyme Care. Individual pay decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Thyme Care employees. The base salary for this role is $195,500-$230,000. The salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired at another level. This position is also bonus-eligible. We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. Weâre here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal-opportunity employer. title: Account Executive - Chicago, IL
description: The Role That We Need: PadSplit is hiring for an Account Executive to expand our marketplace by engaging traditional property owners to become PadSplit Hosts. This role is critical in helping homeowners unlock additional income by listing their properties, while addressing housing affordability by creating more shared housing opportunities in the Chicago, Illinois market. The Person We Are Looking For: We are seeking a driven and personable Account Executive with experience in sales or real estate who excels at building relationships with property owners and real estate investors. This role involves delivering a tailored value pitch on how the PadSplit model and technology consistently drive superior rental income compared to traditional single-family rentals. The ideal candidate thrives in a remote environment, demonstrates strong communication skills, and wants to have an impact on the affordable housing crisis - one room at a time. Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day: Prospect and Qualify Leads: Research and identify potential property owners who might be interested in becoming PadSplit Hosts and qualify them based on suitability. Conduct Outreach: Execute outreach strategies, including cold calling, emailing, and networking, to connect with traditional property owners. Host Discovery Calls and Meetings: Engage property owners in initial conversations to understand their needs, goals, and potential barriers to joining PadSplit. Deliver Value Propositions : Clearly articulate the benefits of PadSplit's model, such as increased revenue potential, simplified management, and societal impact. Build and Nurture Relationships: Develop trust-based relationships with property owners, acting as a trusted advisor to address concerns and highlight opportunities. Tailor Solutions: Customize hosting solutions based on the unique circumstances of property owners, including financial modeling, property suitability, and compliance requirements. Close Deals: Guide property owners through the decision-making process, negotiate terms, and finalize agreements for onboarding as PadSplit Hosts. Collaborate with Onboarding Teams: Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding for new Hosts, providing accurate property details and expectations. Track and Report Metrics: Maintain detailed records in CRM systems, tracking outreach activities, conversion rates, and other key performance indicators. Stay Updated on Market Trends: Monitor the real estate market, competitive landscape, and legislative changes to refine outreach and value propositions effectively. Host Educational Sessions: Organize webinars or in-person sessions to educate property owners on PadSplit’s benefits and address common misconceptions. Here’s what you’ll need to be successful: Sales Experience: Proven success in B2B or B2C sales, particularly in the real estate or property management sectors, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets. Relationship-Building Skills: Strong interpersonal and communication abilities to build trust and long-term relationships with property owners. Self-Motivation and Independence: High level of self-discipline and motivation to thrive in a remote, fast-paced startup environment with minimal supervision. Adaptability and Problem-Solving: Ability to think on their feet, overcome objections, and tailor solutions to meet the unique needs of property owners. Knowledge of Real Estate Markets: Familiarity with the dynamics of real estate investing, rental markets, and property management is highly desirable. Tech Proficiency: Comfortable using CRM systems (we use Salesforce and Hubspot), sales enablement tools, and virtual communication platforms for outreach and reporting. Strong Presentation Skills: Ability to confidently present PadSplit’s value proposition through virtual meetings, calls, or live presentations. Analytical Skills: Capable of interpreting market data, calculating ROI, and presenting financial benefits to potential Hosts. Team Collaboration: Effective at collaborating with cross-functional teams, such as marketing and onboarding, to ensure a seamless experience for new Hosts. Entrepreneurial Mindset: Resilience and resourcefulness to tackle challenges and drive results in a rapidly changing startup environment. PadSplit Core Values: Consistently demonstrate our values of compassionate directness, high integrity, optimism, intellectual curiosity, strong work ethic, empathy, self-awareness. The Interview Process: Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager. If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone call with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes. If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Head of Sales for forty-five (45) minutes. If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with a small panel of key stakeholders for one (1) hour. For this interview, a candidate would present a short case study to the panel for discussion. If warranted, the final step would be an in-person meeting with our Head of Sales at a PadSplit hosted event. If warranted, then we move to offer! Compensation, Benefits, and Perks: Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans Company provided life insurance policy Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays 401(k) plan Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both eligible birth and non-birth parents The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis Compensation Compensation is based on the role's scope, market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals. In addition to the base salary, there is a commission component: The base salary for an AE in Chicago is $70,000 a year with attainable commission structure. The annual commission target for an AE is set at $180,000. To achieve this target, an AE is expected to onboard approximately 80 new hosts annually, with 10 hosts reaching 25 units each year. Additional Information Notice to Applicants: PadSplit participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process. PadSplit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Communications Lead
description: Who we are Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves. We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education. Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions! About this role Yubo doesn't have a PR team yet, and that's exactly why this role exists: to build one from scratch and help Yubo become culturally relevant, resilient to reputational bumps, and a real driver of growth. It's a rare chance to shape a PR function from day one inside a fast-moving global tech company. You'll design how it works, lead our agency partner, and craft the stories, moments and relationships that make people pay attention to Yubo. The role covers everyday consumer stories, corporate communications, and handling sensitive issues or crises when they arise. To start, you'll focus on the US, UK and France, with room to grow from there. You'll report to the Director of Brand & Communications and work closely with teams across the business, especially Brand, Product, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal. You'll own the relationship with our PR agency, making sure they feel like a true extension of the team, and you'll help set up the habits and processes that make PR part of how Yubo works day to day. This is a freelance role on a 6-month contract, with a target start in Q4 2026. title: Technical Customer Support
description: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What Work Looks Like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude. Who You Are You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls. You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things. You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding. You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom. Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said. You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity. You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results. You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack. Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive. Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are. A Plus If You Have Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role. Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps. Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client. Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report. An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment. How We Work Together You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer. Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice: Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask. Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt. Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked. The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on. The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you. This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once. Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too. Benefits Contract type: full-time or part-time Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099). description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.
